verdict.rationale: Mailgun offers 'Domain Sending Keys' — API keys restricted to only POST calls on /messages and /messages.mime for a single domain, which is a concrete least-privilege credential mechanism suitable for scoping an agent's access. However, there's no evidence of broader granular RBAC/permission scoping (e.g., read-only vs. send-only vs. domain-management scopes) or documentation framing this specifically for AI agents. missing for 10: agent-specific credential guidance, fine-grained permission tiers beyond sending, independent confirmation of scoping in practice.
